preArrival.simple: Direct booking on BA/easyJet. ETA required for most (free online). Maritime climate: 2°C to 22°C, rainy. Casual dress, pub culture.
preArrival.detailed:
Flight Consolidators & Hub Routing: LHR (London Heathrow), LGW (Gatwick), MAN (Manchester) major hubs. British Airways (flag carrier), easyJet, Ryanair budget carriers. Direct booking typical. No regional consolidator standard.

Visa & Legal Compliance: ETA (Electronic Travel Authorization) required for most visa-exempt nationalities (free online, 2 years). Visa required for others. Passport valid 6 months beyond stay. Not in Schengen.

Climate & Weather: Maritime. London: 2°C (Jan) to 22°C (July). Edinburgh: 1°C to 19°C. Rain year-round. Pack waterproof jacket, layers. Weather unpredictable (bring options).

Apparel Sourcing: Casual pub culture acceptable. Business attire in cities. Religious sites: modest dress. Size system: UK sizing (different from US/EU). Outdoor gear: Regatta, Berghaus (UK brands).

arrival24h.simple: Power: 230V, 50Hz, Type G sockets (3 rectangular pins). 4G/5G excellent, eSIM available. NFC contactless ubiquitous. Heathrow Express/Elizabeth Line to London.
arrival24h.detailed:
Electrical Infrastructure: 230V, 50Hz. Type G (British 3-pin) sockets with fuse. Unique to UK/Ireland/Malaysia/Singapore. Visual reference: https://www.power-plugs-sockets.com/type-g/

Connectivity & ISP: Average broadband 80+ Mbps. 4G coverage 99%, 5G extensive. ISPs: EE, Vodafone, Three, O2. Tourist eSIM: Airalo, Holafly. Local SIM: EE (~£30/week).

Financial Rails: NFC contactless payment universal (tap-to-pay, contactless cards limit £100). Apple Pay/Google Pay widely accepted. Cash declining but still used. No mobile money. Tipping: 10-15% for service.

Airport-to-City: London LHR: Heathrow Express (£25, 15min) or Elizabeth Line (£10.80, 45min). Gatwick: Gatwick Express (£19.80, 30min) or Southern train (£5.50, 45min). Black cabs (£60-80 to center).

mobility.simple: London Tube (11 lines), buses. No informal transit. Uber/Bolt ride-hailing. Santander Cycles. Excellent walkability, drive on left.
mobility.detailed:
Urban Transit Grids: London: Tube (11 lines), buses, DLR, Overground. Contactless payment (Oyster card or tap card). Manchester: Metrolink trams. Apps: TfL Go, Citymapper. **Drive on left**.

Informal Transit: Limited. Formal systems dominate. No Matatus/Marshrutka-style informal transit.

Micro-Mobility & Ride-Hailing: Uber, Bolt dominant. FreeNow (black cab app). Bike-sharing: Santander Cycles (London), Nextbike (other cities). E-scooters: Lime, Tier (trial zones only).

Pedestrian Infrastructure: Excellent walkability in cities. Sidewalks well-maintained. Pedestrian crossings: zebra crossings with Belisha beacons, cars must stop. Look right first when crossing (traffic from right).

dailyLiving.simple: Delivery: Deliveroo, Just Eat, Uber Eats. Alcohol: supermarket sales, pub hours 11am-11pm. Pharmacy: many OTC, antibiotics Rx. Tap water safe. Pub culture.
dailyLiving.detailed:
E-Commerce & Delivery: Dominant: Deliveroo, Just Eat, Uber Eats. Local: Frichti (London). Grocery delivery: Ocado, Tesco, Sainsbury's. Delivery hours limited on Sundays.

Retail & Alcohol: Open sales in supermarkets, off-licenses, pubs. No state monopoly. Drinking age 18. Pub culture integral. Pubs close 11pm (some 1am). Service charge sometimes added.

Pharmacy: Many OTC medications. Antibiotics Rx-only. Pharmacies: Boots, Superdrug, Lloyds. Pharmacies in supermarkets (Tesco, Sainsbury's). 24h pharmacies in cities.

Beverage & Dietary: Tap water potable nationwide, excellent quality. Zero-sugar options available. Local: tea (with milk), beer (ale, stout), gin. Full English breakfast. Fish and chips.

Buffet Protocols: Hotel buffets: multi-plate common. Traditional: one-plate with refills. Carvery buffets popular. No restrictions on refills.

socialCode.simple: Gifts: avoid white lilies (funerals), wine/chocolate OK. Shoes usually kept on. Dog-friendly (pubs allow). Queuing etiquette, politeness, understated humor.
socialCode.detailed:
Gift-Giving Etiquette: Flowers: avoid white lilies (funerals). Odd numbers not significant. Wine, chocolate, high-quality items appropriate. Host gifts appreciated. Presentation modest.

Household Norms: Shoes usually kept on, unless muddy. Follow host's lead.

Companion Pet Culture: Very dog-friendly. Dogs allowed in pubs (patios, some indoors). Service dogs allowed everywhere. Stray dogs rare. Cat culture present.

Behavioral Matrix: Individualistic, politeness-focused. Queuing culture (queue jumping taboo). 'Please', 'thank you', 'sorry' used frequently. Indirect communication (understated). Punctuality: 5-10 min grace socially. Tipping: 10-15% for service (optional if service charge added). Personal space respected. Pub culture central to social life. Humor: dry, self-deprecating.

preArrival.simple: No consolidator needed - direct booking. ESTA visa waiver (€14) or B1/B2 visa. Varied climate: check destination. Casual dress, beach to business formal.
preArrival.detailed:
Flight Consolidators & Hub Routing: Major hubs: JFK/LGA/EWR (NYC), LAX (LA), ORD (Chicago), ATL (Atlanta), DFW (Dallas). Direct booking typical. No regional consolidator standard. Delta, American, United legacy carriers; Southwest, JetBlue budget.

Visa & Legal Compliance: Visa Waiver Program (ESTA) for 38 countries - 90 days, €14 online. Otherwise B1/B2 tourist visa required. Passport valid 6 months beyond stay. TSA PreCheck/Global Entry programs for frequent travelers.

Climate & Weather: Extremely varied by region. Northeast: -5°C to 30°C. Southwest: 10°C to 40°C. Florida: 15°C to 32°C. Check specific destination. Pack layers for cross-country travel.

Apparel Sourcing: Highly varied by region and context. Business casual in cities, casual elsewhere. Beach culture in coastal areas. Religious sites: modest dress. Size system: US sizing differs (shoes, clothing).

arrival24h.simple: Power: 120V, 60Hz, Type A/B sockets (flat pins). 4G/5G excellent, eSIM from Airalo/T-Mobile. NFC ubiquitous (Apple/Google Pay). Uber/Lyft everywhere.
arrival24h.detailed:
Electrical Infrastructure: 120V, 60Hz. Type A (two flat pins) and Type B (two flat + ground pin) sockets. Type A without ground, Type B with ground. Visual reference: https://www.power-plugs-sockets.com/type-a/

Connectivity & ISP: Average broadband 150+ Mbps. 4G coverage 99%, 5G expanding. ISPs: Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile. Tourist eSIM: Airalo, T-Mobile. Local SIM: T-Mobile Prepaid (~$50/month).

Financial Rails: NFC contactless payment universal. Venmo, Zelle, Cash App for P2P. Credit cards essential (Amex, Visa, MC). Cash still used but declining. Tipping: 15-20% expected.

Airport-to-City: Varies widely by city. NYC: AirTrain + subway ($11.75) or taxi/Uber ($50-70). LA: FlyAway bus ($9.75) or rideshare ($40-80). Public transit quality varies significantly by city.

mobility.simple: Varies: NYC subway excellent, LA car-dependent. Uber/Lyft dominant ride-hailing. Lime/Bird e-scooters. Walkability: high in Northeast, low in Sun Belt.
mobility.detailed:
Urban Transit Grids: Highly variable. NYC: Extensive subway/bus system (MTA). DC: Metro (WMATA). Chicago: 'L' trains. LA: Metro (limited). San Francisco: BART/Muni. Many cities: car-dependent. Transit apps: Citymapper, Transit.

Informal Transit: Limited formal alternatives. Some unofficial shuttles in specific markets, but formal systems dominate.

Micro-Mobility & Ride-Hailing: Uber and Lyft nationwide. Lime, Bird, Spin e-scooters in cities. Citi Bike (NYC), Divvy (Chicago), Bay Wheels (SF) bike shares. Car-sharing: Zipcar, Turo.

Pedestrian Infrastructure: Extremely variable. NYC, Boston, SF: highly walkable. LA, Houston, Phoenix: car-dependent, poor walkability. Sidewalk quality varies. ADA compliance required but inconsistent.

dailyLiving.simple: Delivery: DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub dominant. Alcohol: supermarket sales (age 21). Pharmacy: OTC limited, many Rx-only. Tap water safe. Buffet: AYCE multi-plate.
dailyLiving.detailed:
E-Commerce & Delivery: Dominant: DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub. Local: Postmates. Grocery delivery: Instacart, Amazon Fresh. 24/7 delivery culture in major cities.

Retail & Alcohol: Open sales in supermarkets, liquor stores (21+ ID required). No state monopoly except Pennsylvania (limited). Drinking age 21 strictly enforced. Tipping culture pervasive.

Pharmacy: Limited OTC compared to Europe. Many medications Rx-only (antibiotics, strong painkillers). Pharmacies: CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid. 24h pharmacies common.

Beverage & Dietary: Tap water safe nationwide. Zero-sugar sodas abundant. Local: Dr Pepper, Mountain Dew. Large portion sizes standard. Ice in drinks default.

Buffet Protocols: AYCE (All-You-Can-Eat) multi-plate standard. Refills unlimited. No one-plate restrictions. Hotel buffets: self-serve, multiple plates typical.

socialCode.simple: Gifts: wine, flowers, food items. Shoes usually kept on. Dog-friendly (varies by state). Personal space, direct eye contact, tipping mandatory, casual greetings.
socialCode.detailed:
Gift-Giving Etiquette: Flowers: any number acceptable. Chrysanthemums sometimes associated with death. Wine, regional food, gift cards appropriate. Host gifts appreciated but not mandatory.

Household Norms: Shoes typically kept on, unless requested otherwise. Socks expected if shoes removed.

Companion Pet Culture: Dog-friendly but varies by state/city. Many restaurants allow patios, not indoors. Service dog rights protected. Stray dogs rare in cities.

Behavioral Matrix: Individualistic culture. Large personal space. Direct eye contact valued. Firm handshake greetings. Punctuality: socially 10-15 min grace, business on-time. Tipping: 15-20% mandatory in restaurants, taxis, personal services. Casual dress in many settings. Sunglasses acceptable in many contexts.

preArrival.simple: For Southeast Asian low-cost combinations, compare AirAsia MOVE and Traveloka with Google Flights/Skyscanner; these are booking/search platforms, not the airlines. Apply only through Vietnam's current government e-visa domain.
preArrival.detailed:
Flight routing: Hanoi (HAN) and Ho Chi Minh City (SGN) are the principal gateways; Da Nang (DAD) is useful for central Vietnam. AirAsia MOVE and Traveloka help compare regional options; confirm each leg with the operating airline. Vietnam's immigration portal announced a move to evisa.gov.vn and thithucdientu.gov.vn; use the current official domain.

Entry: E-visa eligibility, validity, and entry points depend on current rules. Check Vietnam Immigration's official portal and your visa approval details before departure; avoid third-party lookalike application sites.

Climate and packing: North, central, and southern regions have different monsoon timing and temperatures. Check city-specific forecasts and storm notices; bring rain protection, breathable clothing, and modest attire for temples.

sources.topic: Vietnam Immigration Department e-visa portal notice

arrival24h.simple: Vietnam uses 110/220 V at 50 Hz with Type A, C, and D sockets; check the accommodation's outlet type. Carry some VND and confirm SIM/eSIM registration options.
arrival24h.detailed:
Power: 110/220 V at 50 Hz; Type A, C, and D sockets are reported. Supply varies by location/building. Check device input and use an adapter; it does not convert voltage.

Connectivity and payments: Check local SIM/eSIM requirements and roaming before landing. QR wallets such as MoMo and ZaloPay are primarily domestic; do not assume visitors can activate them. Keep Vietnamese dong (VND) and a card backup.

Airport transfer: Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City airports have official bus, taxi, and app pickup options. Confirm the airport, pickup zone, and current route; use an official counter or verified in-app vehicle.

mobility.simple: Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City have metro lines alongside buses; Grab, Be, and Xanh SM operate in many cities. Intercity trains use Vietnam Railways booking.
mobility.detailed:
City transit: Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City have metro services alongside buses; routes, hours, and fare systems are still expanding. Use the local operator or station signage for current information.

Ride-hailing and informal travel: Grab, Be, and Xanh SM are options in major urban areas; confirm vehicle details and fare in-app. Xe ôm motorcycle taxis may be app-booked or negotiated; agree terms before riding.

Intercity and walking: Vietnam Railways sells official train tickets; check station names and travel time. Sidewalks can be occupied by parked motorbikes; cross slowly and predictably at marked points.

dailyLiving.simple: GrabFood and ShopeeFood cover many city addresses; confirm coverage in-app. Use bottled water unless local accommodation gives reliable advice for that building.
dailyLiving.detailed:
Delivery: GrabFood and ShopeeFood are common urban options. Coverage, phone-number requirements, cash/card support, and operating hours depend on exact address.

Water and pharmacy: Do not assume tap water is potable. Use sealed bottled water or suitable treatment. Pharmacies are common in cities, but bring essential medicine in original packaging and verify import rules.

Food and payment: Cash in VND remains useful alongside cards and domestic wallets. Ask about ingredients, spice, and allergens. Buffet terms and refill rules are venue-specific.

socialCode.simple: At temples, dress modestly and remove shoes where instructed. Ask before photographing people; use two hands when offering or receiving items if that is the host's cue.
socialCode.detailed:
Temples and homes: Follow posted footwear and clothing rules. Ask whether to remove shoes in a home and follow the host's lead.

Dining and gifts: Ask about dietary needs and observe how shared dishes are served. A small food gift may be welcome, but ask about preferences and avoid assumptions about taboos.

Photography and greetings: Ask permission before photographing people or ceremonies. Greetings vary by age and setting; a polite verbal greeting is a safe default.
